inherited_acquisition_accounting.scope: Reused acquisition subset of V105 total work, including diagnostic and unincorporated costs; overlapping source folds do not incur new draws or multiply physical acquisition.

evidence_scope: Each model scores only its excluded history. Half and full pools contain the other three histories and preserve actual first-batch membership. Half statistics remain fixed during full continuation; both stages perform 1000 Adam steps with zeroed moments. Full models therefore inherit 1000 parameter steps and receive 1000 additional steps. Full-minus-half tests the prescribed additional-data and update package; it does not isolate data volume from extra optimization. The frozen rule applies to both widths and queries. Each fold equally weights its retained roots and the grand mean equally weights all four excluded histories. The source pools overlap, so the four folds are not independent replicates. No crossed training-history cells or new natural rollouts are evaluated. The 64 roots and 10240 terminal references are reused evidence; A/B16 are descriptive partitions of the primary pool32. Bank files are read once, pooling and fitting are charged as executed, and shared acquisition/reference budgets are not multiplied by the folds. Missing decisions or references never shrink the primary cohort. This is a mechanism test, not a scientific Gate.
